narration: The cart ruts end above a square choked with people and runoff. A rumor is moving faster than the bodies: each retelling points the surge toward the belfry. Broken cobbles leave a narrow outer curb, but the middle has become black mud deep enough to catch a boot. The water pump stands above it, handle jerking as shoulders strike its basin. The roof stair remains behind you; a drainage arch opens beyond the crowd.
